title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: This update outlines the rules for the upcoming national team championships, crucial for Indian badminton's domestic competitive landscape.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the official regulations for the 2026 Inter State Team Championships, detailing rules and participation criteria for the national event.

title: BAI Invites Applications for Athlete Committee Positions
indian_angle: Indian athletes are invited to join the Athlete Committee, providing them a direct voice in the sport's governance and development within India.
summary: The BAI has issued an important notification inviting eligible athletes to apply for positions on the Athlete Committee, aiming to enhance player representation in decision-making.

title: Change in Women's Doubles Pair for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: A change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials directly affects India's representation and strategy for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced a change in the women's doubles pair participating in the selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's top young talent for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships, fostering future national stars.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Player Eligibility List for World Junior Championships Trials Released
indian_angle: The list of qualified players for the final selection trials determines who will represent India at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the list of players eligible and qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will impact how young Indian players compete and develop in domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups in domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
